items.headline: RBI maintains repo rate at 5.25%, revises GDP growth forecast upwards
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's MPC unanimously kept the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, aligning with market expectations. The RBI revised its real GDP growth forecast for FY27 upwards to 6.7% and lowered inflation projections for Q2 FY27 to 4.7%. This stable stance supported the Indian rupee and bond market.

items.headline: Cautious global trade, falling crude prices boost FPI interest in India
items.summary: Global markets showed caution with mixed Asian results, but prospects of a US-Iran peace deal pushed Brent crude below $80, easing inflation concerns. Foreign Portfolio Investors continued buying Indian stocks, with $1.27 billion in August and $2.12 billion in July, partly due to a global rotation from AI-heavy markets.

items.headline: Over 160 companies including LIC, Trent, Britannia to report Q1 FY27 earnings
items.summary: August 6, 2026, is a significant day for Q1 FY27 earnings, with 165 companies scheduled to release results. Key companies include Life Insurance Corporation of India, Trent, Britannia Industries, Hero MotoCorp, Lupin, Siemens Energy India, Apollo Tyres, NCC, Kirloskar Oil Engines, Reliance Power, and Sonata Software.

items.headline: Aurobindo Pharma reports 25.98% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit
items.summary: Aurobindo Pharma announced a consolidated net profit of ₹1,033 crore for Q1 FY27, marking a 25.98% year-on-year increase. The company has scheduled its earnings call for today.

items.headline: PB Fintech's Q1 FY27 net profit surges 92%, revenue jumps 40.1%
items.summary: PB Fintech, parent company of PolicyBazaar, reported a 92% year-on-year surge in consolidated net profit to ₹163 crore for Q1 FY27. Revenue from operations also saw a significant jump of 40.1% YoY, reaching ₹1,888.28 crore.

items.headline: Hindalco's subsidiary Novelis reports 23% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net sales
items.summary: Hindalco Industries is in focus after its wholly-owned subsidiary, Novelis, reported a 23% year-on-year increase in net sales to $5.8 billion for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Cummins India Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.38%, profit drops 7.96% YoY; MD resigns
items.summary: Cummins India reported a 16.38% year-on-year increase in standalone revenue to ₹3,375 crore. However, standalone net profit contracted by 7.96% YoY to ₹543 crore, impacted by input inflation. Managing Director Shveta Arya has resigned, effective August 31, 2026.

items.headline: Biocon records substantial 349.4% YoY growth in Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit
items.summary: Biocon reported a significant 349.4% year-on-year growth in its consolidated net profit for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: IT and Automobile sectors lead market rally, banking also strong
items.summary: The IT and Automobile sectors have demonstrated strong performance in 2026, with IT seeing a 16.8% surge in July, its best monthly performance in six years. The banking sector also shows relative strength. These sectors are expected to remain in focus driven by historical seasonality, improving earnings, robust auto sales, and rising EV demand.

items.headline: Linde India, Lumax Industries, Praj Industries among companies trading ex-dividend today
items.summary: Several companies are trading ex-date today for various corporate actions. Linde India, Lumax Industries, Praj Industries, Rane Holdings, and Tasty Bite Eatables are ex-dividend. Genesys International Corporation is ex-rights, while Nexus Select Trust is ex-income distribution.

items.headline: India's M&A outlook robust, driven by technology, energy, and regulatory reforms
items.summary: India's M&A outlook is robust, bolstered by the 2026 Union Budget's growth measures. Cross-border M&A is expected to remain strong in H2 2026, particularly in technology (AI), energy, and supply-chain security. Outbound M&A by Indian companies is also rising for AI capabilities and market access, supported by streamlining regulatory reforms.
